title: Prints sticking to FEP and not the Print Plate
originalText: Prints sticking to FEP and not the Print Plate Hello. I have the Mage S 14K, it worked great for a while, but then prints started to not stick to the plate, and boy oh boy are they sticking to the FEP. The FEP became dented so I changed it out, and it worked fantastic for ONE print. And now nothing sticks again. I’ve done six prints all on different days, nothing sticks to the plate. I’ve setup multiple attempts small prints all over the plate, looking if it is just one area or something, nothing close to each other, and nothing sticks. Well, as stated it sure sticks to the FEP, real pain getting it to come off that, but the plate, nothing. I have no idea how to fix this, Looking at other posts I dont see any real answers? Can anyone help?
titleCn: 打印件粘在 FEP 离型膜上而不粘平台

summaryCn: Mage S 14K 连续六次打印只粘 FEP 不粘平台，换离型膜仅生效一次，属反复性附着失效。

title: K2 Series Flagship Printers - Bed Leveling and Maintenance
originalText: K2 Series Flagship Printers - Bed Leveling and Maintenance Bed Leveling: I’ve done a perfect bed leveling on my K2 Pro. There’s no need for extreme measures. I leveled the bed using the Paper Method, turning the knobs to perfection. I didn’t need sanding, aluminum tape, or anything else. It went from 0.45 to 0.25. Even when it was tilted, my printer was printing flawlessly. You can follow this official Creality video tutorial to perform your leveling, the leveling method starts at 6:24. You must fine-tune each corner at least four times in a circular pattern because when you fine-tune one knob, you mess with the level on the other side. Don’t forget to perform all calibrations after you leveled the bed. You can access the Fluidd web interface by entering the printer’s IP address in your internet browser, plus the door :4408 (example: http://192.168.1.3:4408/ ). Maintenance: I also recommend everybody to perform frequent maintenance on your printers, they will last longer and the printing results will be perfect. Apart from the normal maintenance you see in the video, I also recommend everybody to lubricate all the rollers on the printer frequently. For that, Creality recommends using only WD-40 Specialist Silicone spray. Check this official Creality video for maintenance tips. WD40 specialist Silicone spray 600×359 8.51 KB Levelling 2x 1920×2319 176 KB

title: Hello everyone
originalText: Hello everyone Hello Everyone! My name is Keagan Stephens, all the way from SA! I am 31 years old ,I Live in Eshowe Kwa-Zulu natal 3815 (ZULULAND!) and i Am a Qualified Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant And the owner of Sculptured Realities. My 3d printing Journey Started about 6months ago when i was trying to find a way to make a toy replica of my daughter and had asked a friend of mine whom if fortunate enough to own a Creality Ender KE. I Loved the results and got the cheapest 3d printer i could find which i still use today (easythreed k9 and k10). this was 5 months ago , since then I saved up to get a Creality Halot r6 WHICH WAS ON SALE AT THE TIME. I Really loved the quality prints i got from the Halot R6 and decided to open a business based around 3d Prints specifically aiming to make life like busts that resemble clients likeness, which has gone amazingly well especially since i’ve been unemployed for the past 2 years due to a major unemployment rate the country is facing . since starting i’ve been working with our local bakers trying to fill in the gap by bringing affordable cake toppers and baking related tools such as cookie cutters and stencils etc(we live in a remote area)..i am also currently working on fun kids theme pot planters ,lamps and articulated toys ,keychains and much more which i believe will get kids to get excited about 3d printing and nature as a whole. My future goals for myself and my company is to move on to larger life sized 3d printing aswell as move on to automotive 3d printing applications (mainly engine and interior trimming aswell as afew designer parts). We also aim to start 3d printing lessons for kids which require more high speed printers as so we can print small mini objects evert session which wont take aslong as they do on my current fdm printers. My hopes for this forum and journey as a whole would be to learn more on 3d printing applications and related software, improve my designing skills aswell as simply just to get inspired on my next design. I am also here to learn more about Creality as a brand and Make and hopefully become a pioneer of the brand in future.
